summary: The MaintAgencyProfile document contains the user interface and functionality for managing agency profiles within the HSPnet application. It includes controls for managing documents, requirements, history, closures, security settings, and agency information.
purpose: To provide an interface for users to manage and view various aspects of agency profiles, including documents, requirements, history, closures, security settings, and general agency information.

workflows.name: Manage Agency Profile
steps: Load agency profile data from database
Configure tabs based on agency data availability
Enable or disable tabs based on user permissions and configurations
Set agency profile properties and bind data to controls
Handle UI interactions and events such as tab changes, form submissions, and validations

business_rules: Tabs are enabled or disabled based on user permissions and configuration settings
Agency profile data is loaded from the database using the agency ID
Profile data fields are conditionally displayed based on their content
User sessions determine the visibility and editability of the profile tabs
validations: Ensure the requirement description is provided when required
Check start and end dates for max values
Validate that start date is less than or equal to end date
system_behavior: The system allows users to switch between tabs (Documents, Requirements, History, Closures) based on the current page state
Page client scripts are registered for additional functionalities
Tabs dynamically update headers to reflect the existence of data for particular categories
dependencies: Resources for UI text and labels
exceptions: Handling empty or null fields when binding data to controls
Security checks when enabling profile tabs
